name: Saleen S5S Raptor
description:
The Saleen S5S Raptor is a mid-engine concept supercar revealed at the 2008 New York International Auto Show. Designed as a spiritual successor to the Ford GT-based Saleen S7, the S5S features a carbon fiber monocoque chassis and aggressive aerodynamic bodywork.

Power comes from a supercharged 5.0L V8 engine producing 650 horsepower and 854 Nm of torque, mated to a 6-speed manual transmission driving the rear wheels. The car weighs just 1,451 kg thanks to extensive use of carbon fiber and aluminum.

The S5S Raptor showcases Saleen's vision for an American supercar capable of competing with European exotics, featuring a low-slung profile, prominent rear diffuser, and active aerodynamic elements.
